system.description:
The shallows are in your blood, moving with the rhythm of the sea — fluid and unbound. Though you might walk among those of the shore, the sea always beckons.

Tidal Grace

You have a swim Speed, and you can breathe underwater. [A/M]

You can talk to creatures of the sea if your INT is not negative. [M]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by SanityWithIn.
